metadata.description: Prompt enhancement for ZCode: faithful intent and grounded detail before concision; desktop preview/apply/undo, slash command and MCP tool.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 提示词增强：先忠实保留意图与有依据的细节，再精炼表达；提供桌面按钮、独立预览与回退、斜杠命令和 MCP 工具。

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Prompt enhancer for ZCode: faithful intent first, silent internal project context without leaking metadata into output. Desktop reuses the session model (no extra key) with preview/apply/revert; commands and MCP support optional external providers.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过桌面按钮、/enhance-prompt 或 enhance_prompt 忠实改写草稿：保留任务类型与显式约束，项目上下文仅作内部静默依据、绝不混入输出。桌面复用会话模型无需额外 Key；工具支持 GLM、OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic，命令/技能无 Key 时就地改写。
